seedTimeLimitHint.message: Optional browser-side rules with a separate hour limit per tracker hostname. Saving another tracker does not replace existing rules. Counts Transmission's cumulative seeding time, including seeding without upload traffic, not time since adding the torrent. The tracker's credited time may differ. Chrome must be running; the popup may be closed. Disabled by default.

seedTimeLimitSafety.message: Only completed seeding or seed-queued torrents are stopped; nothing is deleted. Every tracker on a torrent must have the selected hostname. Malformed or mixed-host tracker lists are skipped. Existing torrents are excluded unless explicitly included. Checks run at most once per minute, on normal polling; sleep and background scheduling may delay stopping. Manually restarting a limited torrent does not exempt it. Restored backups require reactivation.

aboutLineage.message: This is the code975 fork of mthcore Transmission Easy Client 3.4.0.

scriptSettingsHint.message: These are optional server-side scripts run by Transmission, not Chrome. In Docker, enter the path inside the container; the file must exist and be executable by the Transmission user. Leave disabled if you do not use a custom script. In Transmission 4.0.6, the seeding-completed event is triggered by the daemon’s own ratio or idle limit, not the extension’s seed-time limit or manual pausing.

networkSettingsHint.message: These settings control the Transmission server’s torrent connections, not the extension’s RPC/HTTP connection.

peerPortHint.message: Port for incoming peer connections, not the RPC port. Expose it through Docker and the firewall, and forward it on the router when needed. The port test checks external reachability; outgoing connections may still work with a closed port.

portForwardingHint.message: UPnP/NAT-PMP requests automatic port forwarding from a compatible router. It does not replace Docker port publishing or firewall rules and may not work through multiple NAT layers or CGNAT.

encryptionHint.message: Protocol encryption for peer connections. Required accepts encrypted connections only; Preferred tries encrypted connections but accepts unencrypted ones; Tolerated tries unencrypted connections but accepts encrypted ones. This is not a VPN, anonymity protection or the RPC HTTPS setting.

dhtHint.message: DHT finds peers through a distributed network, even without a tracker. Transmission does not use it for torrents marked private. Always follow your private tracker’s rules.

pexHint.message: PEX lets connected peers exchange addresses of additional peers. Transmission does not use it for torrents marked private; tracker rules still apply.

lpdHint.message: LPD discovers other torrent clients on the local network. It does not open an internet port or enable local file sharing.

utpHint.message: uTP is UDP-based torrent transport designed to back off during network congestion. It is not necessarily faster and depends on network and UDP reachability.

altSpeedScheduleHint.message: Enables the alternative (turtle) speed limits on the selected days and time interval; it does not stop torrents. It uses the Transmission server/container’s local time, which may differ from Windows time. Configure the limit values in the speed settings.

scriptDoneHint.message: Runs when downloading completes, for example to send a notification or adjust specific permissions. It does not mean seeding has finished.

scriptAddedHint.message: Runs when a new torrent is added; for magnets, after metadata arrives. Useful for logging, for example. Requires Transmission 4.0+.

scriptSeedingHint.message: In Transmission 4.0.6, runs when the daemon reaches its own seed-ratio or idle limit, not on every pause. Manual stops and the code975 seed-time limit do not trigger it.

scriptPathScope.message: Absolute Linux/Docker script-file path on the Transmission server, without surrounding quotes or command-line arguments. Spaces in filenames are allowed; a .sh extension is not required. Only path syntax and the read-back setting are checked; no file is opened and no script is executed.

scriptPathEmpty.message: Enter a file path for the enabled script.

scriptPathControl.message: The path must not contain line breaks, tabs or control characters.

scriptPathWhitespace.message: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from the path.

scriptPathWindows.message: This is a Windows path. For Linux/Docker, enter the path visible inside the container, starting with /.

scriptPathAbsolute.message: An absolute Linux/Docker path starting with / is required.

scriptPathFile.message: Enter a script-file path, not a directory ending with /.

scriptPathMismatch.message: The read-back path differs from the submitted path. Refresh settings and check the server connection.

scriptPathSaveError.message: Could not save or read back the path

scriptPathSaved.message: Path saved; the read-back setting matches. File existence and executability cannot be checked through RPC.

scriptPathUnchecked.message: The format looks valid. File existence and executability are unverified; Apply checks saving and reading back the setting.
